name: DuoStatusBar
author: Muzi
description:
Merges the iPhone status bar's battery, Wi-Fi and cellular signal icons into a single circular widget in the style of the iPhone Duo outer display.

v20 changes:
- Switched to STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar) so the indicator actually lives inside the system status bar rather than being a separate overlay window. Result: no more flash on Control Center / lock screen.
- Smart-invert fix v1.1.1: the icon now reads the resolved foreground colour from the system's own STUIStatusBarSignalStrengthItemView.activeColor (or the label/text view, or the bar's own foregroundColor), so it auto-inverts against any wallpaper like the rest of the status bar. Works for colour tints too, not just b/w.

Settings: position offsets, icon size, ring width, per-element HEX colours, debug log.
changelog:
v1.1.1 (2026-09-14)
- Smart-invert hotfix: read STUIStatusBarSignalStrengthItemView.activeColor / STUIStatusBarStringView.textColor / STUIStatusBar.foregroundColor (in that priority) instead of just foregroundColor, because the foregroundColor alone is a dynamic UIColor that CGContext can't render correctly.
- Resolve all dynamic UIColor values against the screen traitCollection before passing them to CoreGraphics (added DUOStatusBarState -resolve: helper). Without this, drawing a dynamic colour produces wrong RGB.

v1.1.0 (2026-09-14)
- STUIStatusBar-native hook (port from 34306/DuoBar): duo view now lives inside the system status bar instead of being an overlay UIWindow.
- Airplane-mode indicator hook: now renders the airplane glyph when toggled.
- Deprecated DUOStatusBarOverlay class (kept only for ABI).

v1.0.0
- Initial release (UIWindow overlay).
